short: The wooden puppet in Carlo Collodi’s book.
note: The animated wooden puppet in Carlo Collodi’s The Adventures of Pinocchio, first published in installments in the 1880s.

sources.label: Library of Congress · The Adventures of Pinocchio

short: The comic puppet associated with Punch and Judy.
note: Mr. Punch, the combative comic puppet of Punch and Judy, descended from the Italian Pulcinella. Early English versions used marionettes; the familiar later performances use glove puppets.

sources.label: Victoria and Albert Museum · Punch and Judy

short: Bonded from particles by heat or pressure.
note: Made by consolidating powdered material into a solid mass using heat, pressure, or both.
